mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_vector_index ( index_id, collection_type, source_type, source_id, vector_id, user_id, session_id, content_hash, status, failure_message, indexed_at, disabled_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{indexId}, #{collectionType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{vectorId}, #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{contentHash}, #{status}, #{failureMessage}, #{indexedAt}, #{disabledAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE vector_id = VALUES(vector_id), user_id = VALUES(user_id), session_id = VALUES(session_id), content_hash = VALUES(content_hash), status = VALUES(status), failure_message = VALUES(failure_message), indexed_at = VALUES(indexed_at), disabled_at = VALUES(disabled_at), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
